verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents sessions, Media Router features, archiving, SIP interconnect and session-monitoring webhooks. None of it describes a path from a live session into a speech-to-text, model and text-to-speech voice-agent pipeline. SIP interconnect and webhooks are adjacent building blocks, not the documented capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the vendor documents an integration path from a live session to a voice-agent pipeline of speech-to-text, a model, and text-to-speech
